test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 06 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: ΔPQR is an isosceles triangle and PQ = PR = 2a unit, QR = a unit. Draw PX ⊥ QR, and find the length of PX.
solution:
Given:

PQ = PR = 2a

Calculations:

⇒ PX = √(PQ² - (QR/2)²)

⇒√(4a² - a²/4)

⇒ √15a/2

Hence, The Required value of PX = √15a/2.
